subject: Regulus Health — Private/VPC demo intake and narrow availability window
messages:
From: Anna Morales <anna.morales@regulushealth.com>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Private/VPC demo request — Regulus Health

Hi Jordan,

We self-signed up for a Private/VPC demo via the form earlier today. We run regulated clinical workflows and need to evaluate on-prem or VPC deployment options — specifically tenant isolation, audit logs, and evidence for SOC2/hipaa-like policies. Our security team would like a short technical demo focused on deployment topologies and data flow.

Availability: the team has a narrow window on Wed 9/15 AM PST or Thu 9/16 early morning PST. If possible we'd like a 45-minute slot that includes a short ops checklist walk-through and a spot to ask compliance questions.

Attendees: Myself (product lead), our security engineer (security@regulushealth.com).

Two quick asks before we lock a slot:
- Can someone confirm whether Redwood supports on-prem air-gapped installs or a VPC private control plane with customer KMS?
- Can you share a basic audit/evidence pack (SOC2 scope, retention of audit logs) ahead of the demo so our security team can triage?

Thanks — Anna
Anna Morales
Product Lead, Regulus Health
anna.morales@regulushealth.com
(415) 555-0179
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Anna Morales <anna.morales@regulushealth.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private/VPC demo request — Regulus Health

Hi Anna — thanks for the note and the details. Welcome!

Short answers up front: Redwood supports both a customer-managed VPC deployment (private control plane) and an on-prem package for air-gapped environments. We also integrate with KMS/HSM for customer key management and keep configurable audit log retention. I'll loop in our solutions engineer to cover the deep technical bits during the demo.

Proposed slots (45 minutes):
- Wed 9/15 at 9:00 AM PST (preferred)
- Wed 9/15 at 10:30 AM PST
- Thu 9/16 at 7:30 AM PST (if you need earlier in the morning)

If one of those works, I'll lock it and send a calendar invite and attach a short checklist and an NDA stub for your security team to review. If those times don't fit please share an alternate 60-minute block and we'll accommodate.

Attendees from our side: Soojin Lee (SDR, discovery + coordination) and Ethan Park (Solutions Engineer) — Ethan will cover deployment topology, audit logs and KMS/HSM mechanics.

Next steps: pick a slot and I'll follow up with attachments.

— Jordan
Jordan Blake
Enterprise SDR, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com

Thanks — confirmed for Wed 9/15 at 9:00 AM PST (45 minutes). Calendar invite sent from my account (let me know if it doesn't show up).

Attached: redwood_private_demo_checklist.pdf (ops + security topics we'll cover) and an NDA stub (NDA_stub.pdf) — both are short stubs for review.

Quick checklist of what we'll run through in the demo:
- Deployment options: private control plane vs on-prem installer (air-gapped)
- KMS/HSM integration and key rotation patterns
- Audit logs: schema (actions, actor, timestamps), retention configs, export options
- Network/topology considerations and minimal inbound/outbound requirements
- Evidence pack & follow-up: we'll share a SOC2 scoping summary and a sample audit log extract post-demo if needed

Ethan — could you please prepare a 10-minute deep-dive slide + a short demo showing how we surface audit logs and how they can be exported for retention? Also include a quick note on KMS rotation and whether our HSM integrations require customer-managed certs.

Soojin — I’ll hand the logistics to you if anything needs last-minute rescheduling or additional attendees.

Anna — if your security team wants to send a short list of blockers or required artifacts ahead of time, we’ll prioritize those. Otherwise we’ll cover the items above and follow up with written evidence where applicable.

Looking forward to it.

— Jordan
